summary: Bulk Unsubscribe suggestions and the inbox-health email only include senders with a usable unsubscribe link.

statements.why: No problem in logins, payments, DB or secrets.

statements.text: The agent changed suggestions.ts, inbox-health helpers.ts, route.ts and sender-stats.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Real behaviour change in those files.

misses.what: The 'Suggested' list on Bulk Unsubscribe no longer shows senders without a working unsubscribe link, so users may see fewer suggestions.
The inbox-health email only counts senders with an unsubscribe link, so counts drop and some users who used to get it won't.
Sender stats now prefer an http(s)/mailto unsubscribe link over junk values, so more Unsubscribe buttons work.
